# Don't allow the creation of modules with special "go" or "toolchain" paths.
! bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod go
! stderr 'panic'
stderr 'invalid module path'

! bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod toolchain
! stderr 'panic'
stderr 'invalid module path'

# A module that contains the path element "go" is okay.
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod example.com/go
stderr 'creating new go.mod'

# bolero mod edit won't allow a reserved module path either
! bolero mod edit -module=go
stderr 'invalid -module'

# The bolero command should check for work modules for bad
# names to return a proper error and avoid a panic.
cp badmod.txt go.mod
! bolero list
! stderr panic
stderr 'invalid module path'

-- badmod.txt --
module go
